prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Secure Your Pet & Progress Permanently", "Sign in to ensure your desktop pet, customized items, and memory state are safely saved to your account and recoverable anytime."]
1: ["Select Your Ideal Companion", "Choose a starter pet and select key traits to tailor their desktop interactions.", "Choose Companion Traits"]
2: ["Preparing Desktop Pet Environment", "Initial rendering setup is underway. Your pet will land on your desktop momentarily.", "Desktop Engine Initializing..."]
3: ["Pet Personality Diagnostic", "Answer three quick questions to customize how your pet behaves on your desktop.", "Select Behavioral Style"]
4: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Companion", "Here is a quick checklist of how to interact with, hide, or manage your new pet.", "Essential Desktop Pet Controls"]
5: ["Choose Your Onboarding Path", "Pick between an instant ready-to-go companion or create a custom pet tailored to your desktop."]
6: ["Signing in links your pet safely to your account so your desktop friend is preserved across updates."]
7: ["Verifying Desktop Render Capabilities", "Checking graphics overlay and desktop permissions to guarantee smooth pet rendering.", "System Overlay Readiness"]
8: ["Upload Pet Generation Image", "Provide a clear front-facing photo for optimal custom pet rendering."]
9: []

verdicts.problem: Asks for personal information by requiring a personal photo
